# ring-resize

Source: https://github.com/n3r4zzurr0/svg-spinners/blob/main/svg-css/ring-resize.svg
Copyright (c) Utkarsh Verma. MIT license, included in LICENSE.

ConnectionLoadingIndicator.kt ports the SVG's 24-unit geometry, rounded 3-unit stroke,
2-second linear rotation and 1.5-second CSS ease-in-out dash keyframes to Android Canvas.
Only size and stroke color adapt to the app. No WebView or SVG runtime is required.
